"''The act has much more impact there.|Iella Wessiri and Elscol Loro|}} The '''Dlarit estate''' was the [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferran]] home of the [[Dlarit family]], who were made wealthy and powerful through their dealings with the [[Xucphra Corporation]]. The multi-floor mansion was owned by [[Aerin Dlarit]] and was the childhood home of his daughter [[Erisi Dlarit]], future [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Imperial Intelligence Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]]. The multi-floor mansion was located in a remote spot among Thyferran [[Tree/Legends|rainforests]] on a small knoll at the foot of high mountains that had once been part of an extinct [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]]. [[Water/Legends|Waterfalls]] cascading down the mountains behind the Dlarit estate gave it the visual appearance of a paradise. Almost all travel to the remote mansion took place by [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], and the estate was protected by an elaborate security system that included [[G-003 Tri-Tracker|Tritracker Air Defense battery]] [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|cannons]], [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]], and patrols of [[Human/Legends|Human]] guards. During the [[Bacta War]], in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[Raid on the Dlarit estate|Dlarit estate was raided]] by a [[Elscol Loro's anti-Imperial organization|group]] of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] led by [[Elscol Loro]] and [[Sixtus Quin]], who planned to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Aerin Dlarit due to his high-profile position as a [[General/Legends|general]] with the [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]]. The mercenaries successfully infiltrated the estate by exploiting a weakness among the sensor arrays on the mansion's mountain side. However, at the suggestion of [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]], a former [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agent assisting Loro's group, they decided to publicly humiliate Aerin rather than kill him. ==Description== ===Location=== [[File:Thyferra-FF87.png|thumb|left|180px|The Dlarit estate was located on the planet Thyferra.]] The Dlarit estate was owned by the [[Politics/Legends|politically]] and corporately influential [[Aerin Dlarit]], the patriarch of the [[Dlarit family]]. The mansion was located in a remote area of [[Tree/Legends|rainforests]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], known as [[Thyferra Knoll]], where it was surrounded by a dense area of [[akonije tree]]s and other flora. The building was set on a small knoll at the lower portion of a group of high mountains, which were once part of an extinct [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]]. [[Water/Legends|Waterfalls]] cascaded down the mountains to the rear of the mansion. The result was a backdrop that [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]—who infiltrated the Dlarit estate in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]—found to be visually impressive, with one even referring to the view from the mansion's front as paradisiacal. The estate itself was made of natural stone, and its location at the foot of the mountains made it appear to tower over the rain forests when seen from a distance. Breezes from the mountains and the mist of the waterfalls helped combat the heat from the humid [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] outside the mansion and also created a constant hum of natural background noises. Due to the remoteness of the Dlarit estate and the forest terrain surrounding it, almost all travel to and from the mansion took place by [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]. Only one single-lane track navigated the terrain southward from the estate to a main through-way. Visitors had to pass several gates along the forty-five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]–long path as it meandered through the forests and around the natural rock outcroppings. The rain forests around the mansion gave way to a large clearing at the front of the Dlarit estate. An electronically locked, enclosed solarium served as the entrance to the building. The solarium led to a doorway into the lower floor of the main estate house. From there, a stairway led to the main floor, where a large hallway had several doors to the mansion's various rooms. Among those rooms was the private office of Aerin Dlarit, which included a high-backed chair and a desk with a built-in [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] plate. The plate displayed a slowly rotating [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] replica of a statue of Aerin Dlarit atop a pedestal surrounded by throngs of well-wishers applauding at the base. ===Security=== The thick rainforest foliage, huge mountains and thunderous waterfalls surrounding the Dlarit estate already served as a natural obstacle for those attempting to reach the mansion. Nevertheless, the building was further reinforced by multiple, elaborate security measures installed around the estate. The estate was protected by a ring of well-hidden [[G-003 Tri-Tracker|Tritracker Air Defense batteries]] and ground-based [[Anti-aircraft weaponry|anti-aircraft artillery]] [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|cannons]] designed by [[CoMar Combat Systems/Legends|CoMar Combat Systems]]. Additionally, the multiple gates and natural rock outcroppings along the lone pathway served as ambush points in the event of an invasion. Furthermore, various [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] were positioned around the estate to monitor anyone attempting to approach through the rainforest. The arrays were muted on the mountain side of the estate, however, so that the movement of water and sound from the waterfalls did not constantly trigger alarms. This proved to be a major security weakness exploited by an [[Ashern strike team]] during a [[raid on the Dlarit estate]] in 7 ABY. In addition to the elaborate electronic security system, patrols of [[Human/Legends|Human]] guards made regular rounds both inside and outside the mansion. The external patrols focused their efforts primarily on the side of the estate facing the mountains and waterfalls. ==Occupants== [[File:Erisi_Dlarit.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The Dlarit estate was the childhood home of Erisi Dlarit.]] The Dlarit estate was owned by Aerin Dlarit, a multi-millionaire who was heavily involved in the [[Xucphra Corporation]], one of the two [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]-production and distribution corporations on Thyferra.''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]'' It was also the childhood home of [[Erisi Dlarit]], Aerin Dlarit's daughter, who became a highly-placed [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|chief]] [[Ysanne Isard]]. In that capacity, Erisi Dlarit was placed as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] elite [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], where she provided intelligence information directly to Isard. After the New Republic [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|recaptured Coruscant]], Erisi Dlarit realized her identity was about to be compromised and she fled from Rogue Squadron. Afterward, she ran the fighter wing of Isard's newly-formed [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]]. Following a planetwide coup supported by Isard and Xucphra Corporation in 7 ABY that led to the [[Bacta War]], Aerin Dlarit was promoted to [[General/Legends|general]] in the defense organization. During this time, he continued to live at Dlarit estate, which also included a large staff of servants and maintenance employees tended to the home. ==History== {{SeeAlso|Raid on the Dlarit estate}} {{Quote|He's made himself an obvious target. If we take him out we will rock Xucphran society to its foundations.|Elscol Loro, regarding Aerin Dlarit|}} Although Aerin Dlarit was largely a figurehead in the [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]], his high-profile status made him a strong symbolic target for [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] at the hands of an [[Elscol Loro's anti-Imperial organization|anti-Imperial]] mercenary group led by [[Elscol Loro]] and [[Sixtus Quin]], who agreed to help the local freedom fighters attempt to wrest control of Thyferra back from Isard. The mercenaries planned to infiltrate the Dlarit estate and kill Aerin Dlarit; the prevailing feeling was that committing the assassination inside his own home would add greater impact to the deed. Loro's group were assisted by the [[Ashern]], a group of [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] fighting against Human control of the bacta cartel. The Vratix were the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of Thyferra who had produced bacta for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before their business efforts were dampened by the monopolies of Xucphra and their rival company, the [[Zaltin Corporation]]. To help Loro, the Ashern [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into planetary [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and conducted surveillance on the mansion using [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] owned by Zaltin. In doing so, Loro's team discovered that the sensor devices along the mountain side of the estate were muted and this was therefore a weak spot from which to launch their attack. During the raid, the mercenaries successfully infiltrated the mansion, killing two security guards and [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] Dlarit in his office. [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]], a former New Republic agent working with Loro on the team, at that moment suggested a different plan. Rather then [[Death/Legends|killing]] Dlarit, they stripped him naked and created a hologram of the humiliation, which served the [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] purpose of weakening the will of both the Xucphra Corporation and the Thyferran Home Defense Corps. ==Behind the scenes== The Dlarit estate was created by [[Michael A. Stackpole]] for his [[1997]] novel ''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]'', the fourth installment in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''X-Wing'' series]] of novels. ==Appearances== *''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]'' {{Ab|X-Wing: The Bacta War (unabridged audiobook)}} {{1st|in book}} ==Sources== *''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'' {{1stp}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Estates]] [[Category:Thyferra locations]]
